commit_chain.one_commit_lag_is_structural: build.cjs embeds the git HEAD short-SHA current AT BUILD TIME. Committing that build is itself a commit, so the embedded reference is always exactly one commit behind the commit that contains it -- for any terminal commit, in any chain, permanently, by this build system's design. Proven non-drift: 'git diff 56ca3f6e e9b8c664 --stat' shows exactly one file changed (v2.0-ec/zombie-survivors.html, 6 lines -- the embedded stamp strings only); the source_input_fingerprint reported by tools/build_freshness_gate.mjs (82dbceecc4aa2985) is IDENTICAL before and after this commit, over the same 60 declared source inputs. Same convention already established in this Arcade repo's own v3.1.22-SP CANDIDATE.json ('one-commit stamp lag by design'). Owner-confirmed 2026-09-21: treat as this precedent, not a general BUILD_STALE waiver.
